# synomosai-company-vision

> SynomosAI company vision and stance document (Chinese, v0.1): the four-pillar system Identity · Traceability · Governance · Symbiosis — when AI enters commerce, trust is the only hard currency.

A content-only repo (self-contained HTML vision page + PNG diagram + SVG logo). It is the stance anchor of the SynomosAI ecosystem; it states the worldview but runs no checks.

## Core

- [README.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/synomosai-company-vision/blob/main/README.md): bilingual overview, quick start, layout
- [gov_vision_zh_v0.1-company-vision.html](https://github.com/SynomosAI/synomosai-company-vision/blob/main/gov_vision_zh_v0.1-company-vision.html): the main vision document (Chinese, open in a browser)
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/SynomosAI/synomosai-company-vision/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT

## Optional

- [README.en.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/synomosai-company-vision/blob/main/README.en.md): English overview
